tyrion_veltras.name: Tyrion Veltras

canon_ref.note: Named in 3.42 (Typhenous reports to him); first seen here. He has not met Magnolia in four years. Class level not given.

tyrion_veltras.summary: The head of House Veltras, a stern lord and warrior with great sway over the northern nobles. He wants the Drakes bled by the Goblins before the Humans move on Liscor.

patricia_melissar.name: Patricia Melissar

canon_ref.note: Hosts the gathering and is murdered there (b5.b_patricia_melissar_murdered_at_the_gathering). Class not named.

patricia_melissar.summary: The lady of House Melissar, who hosts the northern nobles' meeting.

eliasor.name: Eliasor

canon_ref.note: Nine years old. Surname not given in this chapter; assumed House Melissar because Magnolia names him its head.

eliasor.summary: Patricia Melissar's young son. After her murder, Magnolia names him head of his house.

bethal.name: Bethal

canon_ref.note: The ebook gives no surname here. The wiki surname comes from the web serial and is not used.

bethal.summary: A fierce lady of the north and an old friend of Magnolia's. She suspects Magnolia of sending an assassin, then joins her circle again.

thomast.name: Thomast

canon_ref.note: Uses the Skill [Affair of Honor] to force a duel. Class not named. He is at Bethal's side.

thomast.summary: A quiet noble swordsman who kills the assassin in a duel of honour.

pryde.name: Pryde

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

pryde.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

wuvren.name: Wuvren

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

wuvren.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

zanthia.name: Zanthia

canon_ref.note: Named only; she joins Magnolia's re-formed circle.

zanthia.summary: A northern noble whom Magnolia calls back to her side.

venith_crusland.name: Venith Crusland

canon_ref.note: History only (4.00K-4.06K). Skill [Flawless Defence]. Refuses Flos in 4.02K, rejoins him in 4.05K.

venith_crusland.summary: An old vassal of Flos who once tried to kill him for a bounty, then served him. He duels Flos, refuses him, and then rides to save him.

maresar.name: Maresar

canon_ref.note: History only. Once a [Bandit Lord]. Venith's wife. Leads Reim's archers.

maresar.summary: Venith's wife, a former bandit leader and a deadly archer. She joins Flos before her husband does.

calac_crusland.name: Calac Crusland

canon_ref.note: History only. Tries to spear Flos in 4.02K; warns Mars of the ambush in 4.05K.

calac_crusland.summary: Venith and Maresar's son, who hates Flos at first and later warns Reim of an ambush.

tengrip.name: Tengrip

canon_ref.note: History only. Retired; his wrist is broken in the ambush (4.05K).

tengrip.summary: An old retired soldier of Reim who takes up his axe again for his king.

uleth.name: Uleth

canon_ref.note: History only. Very likely killed by [Storm Keep] in 4.05K. The date in our calendar is unknown, so he is dead at the start of Book 5 data.

uleth.summary: The general of the six-nation army that marched on Reim.

siyal.name: Siyal

canon_ref.note: History only. Son of Queen Calliope; Flos killed his father, King Treland.

siyal.summary: The Prince of Hellios, who leads his nation into the war against Reim.
